# Check if there are any rows where 'lifetime achievement' is 'na' and year > 1998
# Also need to ensure that 'na' did not win in any year <= 1998
# First, get years where 'lifetime achievement' is 'na'
na_years = df[df['lifetime achievement'] == 'na']['year'].tolist()

# Check if any of those years are > 1998
na_after_1998 = any(year > 1998 for year in na_years)

# Check if 'na' won in any year <= 1998
na_up_to_1998 = any(year <= 1998 for year in na_years)

# The statement is true if 'na' won after 1998 and did not win in or before 1998
answer = na_after_1998 and not na_up_to_1998
